documents.title: Research Needs — Multi-Agent Robotic Systems (MARS) Platform
documents.author: Dhamdhawach Horsuwan
documents.summary: Identifies the 8 core research needs (RN-01 to RN-08) for a mobile robot platform supporting multi-agent experiments based on practical experience operating a four-robot team: fleet scalability, decentralized coordination, behavioral consistency, hardware/software adaptability, fleet-level endurance, environmental interaction, centralized telemetry/logging, and usability/reproducibility.

versions.author: Dhamdhawach Horsuwan
changes: Initial baseline release of MARS Research Needs specification (RN-01 through RN-08)
RN-01 & RN-02: Defined fleet scalability, cost-effectiveness, and decentralized inter-robot communication needs
RN-03 & RN-04: Established locomotion/sensing consistency and modular hardware/software extensibility needs
RN-05 & RN-06: Specified fleet-level power/charging operations, obstacle avoidance, and cooperative transport needs
RN-07 & RN-08: Defined centralized experimental monitoring/telemetry and cross-disciplinary reproducibility needs
